memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- COPD: stable on tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD. No exacerbation in past month. Plan: continue inhalers, check inhaler technique.
- CAD: on aspirin 75 mg OD, atorvastatin 40 mg HS, metoprolol 25 mg OD, isosorbide mononitrate 20 mg OD, GTN SOS. No angina. Plan: continue meds, lipid profile due.
- Osteoporosis: on alendronate 70 mg weekly, calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3. Plan: continue, DEXA due.
Weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (male cutoff 90 cm). Diet: breakfast - idli with sambar, lunch - rice with dal and veg, dinner - roti with paneer, snack - fruit.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.90 L (78% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.58 (58%). Below normal, consistent with moderate obstructive pattern.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Chest X-ray PA: lungs show hyperinflated fields, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax. Cardiac silhouette within normal limits. No acute changes.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 190 mg/dL (<200), LDL 112 mg/dL (<100 borderline high), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40 low), triglycerides 160 mg/dL (<150 borderline).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- COPD: stable, inhaler adherence good. Plan: continue current regimen.
- CAD: LDL 112 mg/dL slightly above target. Plan: increase atorvastatin to 40 mg HS (already) – consider adding ezetimibe if LDL remains >100 after 3 months; continue aspirin, metoprolol, isosorbide.
- Osteoporosis: no new fracture. Plan: continue alendronate, calcium/vit D.
- Diabetes: HbA1c 7.2% – advise tighter diet, consider adding metformin 500 mg BD if tolerated.
Weight 67 kg, waist 86 cm.
Due: HbA1c 2025-10-10.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past week I have felt more short of breath on walking to the auto stand, need to use my salbutamol inhaler 3-4 times a day, and have mild wheezing. No fever or sputum change.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- COPD: acute exacerbation likely, increased rescue inhaler use, wheeze on exam. Plan: start oral prednisolone 40 mg OD for 5 days, continue tiotropium, budesonide-formoterol BD, salbutamol SOS as needed.
- CAD: stable, no chest pain. Plan: continue current meds.
- Osteoporosis: stable. Plan: continue alendronate, calcium/vit D.
Weight 66 kg, waist 85 cm.
Due: HbA1c 2025-10-10; repeat spirometry in 2 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Spirometry repeat: FEV1 1.85 L (60% predicted), FVC 3.00 L (81% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.62 (62%). Mild improvement post-steroid course.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: DEXA scan lumbar spine L1-L4: T-score -2.6; femoral neck T-score -2.1. Diagnosis: osteoporosis. No vertebral fractures visualized.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-04-15 09:00 to 2026-04-10 10:30 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- COPD: stable on tiotropium OD, budesonide-formoterol BD, salbutamol SOS as needed. No exacerbation since steroid course.
- CAD: LDL repeat 108 mg/dL (still borderline). Plan: continue atorvastatin 40 mg HS, consider lifestyle reinforcement.
- Osteoporosis: T-score -2.6 spine, -2.1 hip. Plan: continue alendronate weekly, calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3, ensure adequate vitamin D levels.
- Diabetes: HbA1c 7.0% (drawn today). Plan: continue diet, consider metformin 500 mg BD if tolerated.
Weight 65 kg, waist 83 cm (male cutoff 90 cm).
Due: HbA1c 2026-07-10; lipid profile 2026-04-10 (annual).
